Automating Finance Operations

join our vision

Driven by Purpose.
Defined by People.

Extreme Ownership

Own the outcome, not the task.

Every commit, every customer call, every dollar. Owned end to end. We don’t hand off, we hand over. The person closest to the work sets the bar, then raises it.

Customer Centric

Finance sets the pace.

We talk to controllers and CFOs every week. What we ship reflects their reality, not our assumptions.

Team Game

The Best Idea Wins.

Titles don’t decide, outcomes do. We share credit generously because the work is bigger than any one of us.

Play Long & Simple

Compound beats clever.

We build systems that outlast the hype cycle. If a controller can’t follow it in 90 seconds, it isn’t simple enough.

Next Level

Get Better Every Week.

What was great last week is the floor for this one. Everyone here is expected to redefine what good looks like, including the founders.
